name: Sotrama Settings

fields.label: Algerian Company
fields.description: Optional registration details for Algerian legal entities. Company remains the standard ERPNext record.

fields.label: Company registration identifiers
fields.description: Add the Algerian identifiers to the standard ERPNext Company form. NIF uses ERPNext's existing Tax ID field; Sotrama adds Article d'imposition, NIS, RC and Capital Social.

fields.label: Show additional Algerian fields
fields.description: Enable the additional Article d'imposition, NIS, RC and Capital Social fields on the standard Company form. They appear only when Company Country is Algeria. Enter NIF in ERPNext's Tax ID field. Turning this off hides Sotrama-managed fields but preserves their metadata and saved values.

fields.label: HR & Designations
fields.description: Prepare the French BTPH job-title catalogue in the standard Frappe HR Designation master.

fields.label: BTPH job-title catalogue
fields.description: Add the curated French public-works job titles to Frappe HR. Employees and their assignments continue to be managed in the standard HRMS Employee form.

fields.label: Import BTPH job titles on save
fields.description: When checked and saved, Sotrama adds only missing entries from the curated 202-title French BTPH list to HRMS > Designation. This creates job-title master records only; it does not create Employees or assign jobs. After the first import, use Create Missing Job Titles to add later catalogue additions. Existing designations are never renamed, overwritten or deleted.

description: Central Sotrama setup for Algerian Company registration and the Frappe HR job-title catalogue. Fleet operating policies are available from Fleet Settings.
